detail: ok: got 11639.99, expected 11639.99 | ok: got '211/286', expected '211/286' | ok: got 72.0, expected 72.0 | ok: got 5002.25, expected 5002.25
answer:
Part A: Each period multiplies by \(1.015 \times 0.995 = 1.009925\). Applying the 12 contributions sequentially gives:
\(5000 \to \cdots \to 11639.988275891056\), so **$11,639.99**.

Part B: Total draws \(= \binom{13}{3}=286\). All different \(=5\cdot 3\cdot 5=75\).  
So probability at least two share \(=1-\frac{75}{286}=\frac{211}{286}\).

Part C:  
\(70710 \times 9631 \times 549 \times 7786 = 2,910,978,272,857,140\).  
Digit sum \(=72\).

Part D: Applying transactions, fees (none triggered), and monthly 0.4% interest gives:
\(4300.00 \to \cdots \to 5002.247865174925\), so **$5,002.25**.

FINAL: 11639.99; 211/286; 72; 5002.25
